# MovieBox protocol provenance

The request signing and MovieBox API conventions in `../../moviebox_source.py`
were adapted from [MovieBox-Tui](https://github.com/mesamirh/MovieBox-Tui).
The adapter identifies this upstream in its source header.

The bundled MIT notice was retrieved from upstream revision
`4598d5497bb902ee7dceb540da2240ec9c7ccdc3` on 2026-11-14. This records the notice source;
it does not assert that this revision was the original adaptation baseline.
See [LICENSE-MIT](LICENSE-MIT). No upstream application binaries are bundled.
